reading: New interviews with former BBC News presenter Huw Edwards have caused a backlash, meaning a strong negative public reaction.
In 2024, Edwards was convicted of offences involving sexual images of children.
He has been interviewed for a Channel 4 documentary and a podcast by the Observer and Tortoise Media.
The prime minister's spokesperson said broadcasters should act responsibly and consider their audiences when deciding what to show.
The spokesperson said victims of child sexual abuse should come first and expressed no interest in hearing Edwards' account.
However, the spokesperson said Channel 4 was independent and could make its own decisions about individual programmes.
Channel 4 defended the documentary, saying its director challenged Edwards about his actions and placed no limits on the topics discussed.
A comment in the report said any programme featuring Edwards needed to challenge his past actions and raise unanswered questions.
A statement in the report said people convicted of these serious crimes must face the consequences of their actions.
Duncan Craig, who leads an organisation supporting male survivors of sexual abuse, said media companies seemed to be ignoring the victims.
Craig said he believed in rehabilitation, or helping people change after committing crimes, but did not think these programmes offered it.
The documentary and podcast are due to be released on Tuesday, with some material expected from the Observer on Sunday.

vocabulary.definition: A strong negative reaction from a group of people.
Officially found by a court to have committed a crime.
The people who watch or listen to programmes.
Able to make its own decisions about its programmes.
Gave reasons to support something after other people criticised it.
Ask difficult questions about someone's actions instead of simply accepting their explanation.
The results of someone's actions, especially unpleasant ones.
The process of helping someone change their behaviour after committing a crime.

entries.ja: ある集団の人々が示す強い否定的な反応。

entries.zh-Hans: 一群人表现出的强烈负面反应。
entries.es: Una fuerte reacción negativa de un grupo de personas.
entries.pt-BR: Uma forte reação negativa de um grupo de pessoas.
entries.fr: Une forte réaction négative de la part d’un groupe de personnes.
entries.de: Eine starke negative Reaktion einer Gruppe von Menschen.

entries.ja: 犯罪を犯したと裁判所によって正式に認定された。
entries.zh-Hans: 被法院正式认定犯了罪。
entries.es: Declarado oficialmente culpable por un tribunal de haber cometido un delito.
entries.pt-BR: Considerado oficialmente culpado por um tribunal de ter cometido um crime.
entries.fr: Reconnu officiellement par un tribunal comme ayant commis une infraction pénale.
entries.de: Von einem Gericht offiziell für schuldig befunden, eine Straftat begangen zu haben.

entries.ja: 番組を見たり聞いたりする人々。
entries.zh-Hans: 观看或收听节目的人们。
entries.es: Las personas que ven o escuchan programas.
entries.pt-BR: As pessoas que assistem a programas ou os ouvem.
entries.fr: Les personnes qui regardent ou écoutent des émissions.
entries.de: Die Menschen, die Sendungen ansehen oder anhören.

entries.ja: 自らの番組について独自に決定できる。
entries.ko: 자체 프로그램에 대해 스스로 결정할 수 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 能够自主决定与自身节目有关的事项。
entries.es: Capaz de tomar sus propias decisiones sobre sus programas.
entries.pt-BR: Capaz de tomar suas próprias decisões sobre seus programas.
entries.fr: Capable de prendre ses propres décisions concernant ses émissions.
entries.de: In der Lage, selbst über die eigenen Sendungen zu entscheiden.

entries.ja: 他の人々から批判されたものを支持する理由を述べた。
entries.ko: 다른 사람들이 비판한 것에 대해 이를 지지하는 이유를 제시했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 在某事受到他人批评后，提出了支持它的理由。
entries.es: Dio razones para apoyar algo después de que otras personas lo criticaran.
entries.pt-BR: Apresentou razões para apoiar algo depois que outras pessoas o criticaram.
entries.fr: A donné des raisons de soutenir quelque chose après que d’autres personnes l’ont critiqué.
entries.de: Nannte Gründe, um etwas zu unterstützen, nachdem andere es kritisiert hatten.

entries.ja: 相手の説明をそのまま受け入れるのではなく、その人の行動について答えにくい質問をすること。
entries.ko: 상대방의 설명을 그대로 받아들이는 대신 그 사람의 행동에 대해 답하기 어려운 질문을 하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 针对某人的行为提出难以回答的问题，而不是简单地接受其解释。
entries.es: Hacer preguntas difíciles sobre las acciones de alguien en lugar de aceptar sin más su explicación.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer perguntas difíceis sobre as ações de alguém em vez de simplesmente aceitar sua explicação.
entries.fr: Poser des questions difficiles sur les actes d’une personne au lieu d’accepter simplement ses explications.
entries.de: Schwierige Fragen zu den Handlungen einer Person stellen, anstatt ihre Erklärung einfach zu akzeptieren.

entries.ja: ある人の行動によって生じる結果、特に好ましくないもの。
entries.ko: 누군가의 행동으로 생기는 결과, 특히 좋지 않은 결과.
entries.zh-Hans: 某人的行为所带来的结果，尤其是不好的结果。
entries.es: Los resultados de las acciones de alguien, especialmente los desagradables.
entries.pt-BR: Os resultados das ações de alguém, especialmente os desagradáveis.
entries.fr: Les résultats des actes d’une personne, en particulier les résultats désagréables.
entries.de: Die Folgen der Handlungen einer Person, besonders unangenehme Folgen.

entries.ja: 犯罪を犯した人が自分の行動を改められるよう支援する過程。
entries.ko: 범죄를 저지른 사람이 자신의 행동을 바꾸도록 돕는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 帮助犯过罪的人改变自身行为的过程。
entries.es: El proceso de ayudar a alguien a cambiar su comportamiento después de haber cometido un delito.
entries.pt-BR: O processo de ajudar alguém a mudar seu comportamento depois de ter cometido um crime.
entries.fr: Le processus qui consiste à aider une personne à changer de comportement après avoir commis une infraction pénale.
entries.de: Der Prozess, bei dem einer Person geholfen wird, ihr Verhalten zu ändern, nachdem sie eine Straftat begangen hat.
